title: Collecting and Reading Data
introduction: Learn collecting and reading data through explanations and practice.
definition: Collect simple data by sorting and counting objects. A tally records each object with a mark. A pictograph uses pictures to show data; in this lesson each picture represents one item.

visuals.label: Fruit votes
visuals.alt: Fruit votes — One dot represents one vote.

examples.question: Three pupils choose apples and five choose bananas.
A pictograph has four book symbols. Each symbol represents one book.

exercises.question: Cats: 4, dogs: 6. How many pets altogether?
Red: 3, blue: 7. Which colour has more votes?
Red: 3, blue: 7. How many more blue votes?
Each picture represents one book. How many books do 3 pictures represent?
How many tally marks represent five objects?
exercises.solution: A group of five tally marks has four upright marks and one crossing mark: 4 + 1 = 5.

summary: Collect simple data by sorting and counting objects. A tally records each object with a mark. A pictograph uses pictures to show data; in this lesson each picture represents one item.
